panels.title: Big questions
points: Why does a whale need a heart but an amoeba does not?

panels.title: Islamic foundation
panels.text: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'In the body there is a piece of flesh which, if it is sound, the whole body is sound... it is the heart' (Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim). The physical heart is the centre of the transport system.

keywords.def: surface area divided by volume; smaller in bigger organisms
carries water and mineral ions from the roots
protein in red blood cells that carries oxygen
white blood cell that ingests pathogens

panels.title: Revision: movement of substances and transport in plants and humans
points: Small organisms: large SA:V, diffusion enough
Large organisms: small SA:V, need transport systems
Red cells: haemoglobin, no nucleus, biconcave

panels.title: Explain how red blood cells are adapted to carry oxygen. [3 marks]
points: No nucleus: more room for haemoglobin
Biconcave shape: large surface area for diffusion
Answer: Each feature linked to its function
